advertising.name: Advertising consent
advertising.description: An application for all types of advertisements and signs

approval-condition.name: Approval of details reserved by condition
approval-condition.description: An application to have conditions approved which have been applied at the time of granting a planning permission to limit and control the way in which the planning permission has been implemented

cert-alt-appropriate-dev.name: Certificate of alternative appropriate development
cert-alt-appropriate-dev.description: This enables the claimant under a compulsory purchase scheme to request that their local planning authority review their site and consider what development could have occurred in a ‘no scheme world’.

change-of-use.name: Change of use planning application
change-of-use.description: A change of use planning application is required when there's a significant alteration in how a property is used, moving it from one 'use class' to another as defined in the Use Classes Order. Most changes of use require permission, but some are permitted under specific circumstances. The need for an application depends on whether the change is considered 'material' and the specific regulations from each LPA.

cho-agri-to-dwh.name: Change of use from agricultural buildings to dwellinghouses
cho-agri-to-dwh.description: Change of use from agricultural or former agricultural buildings to dwellinghouses

cho-agri-to-flexcom.name: Change of use from agriculture to flexible commercial use
cho-agri-to-flexcom.description: Change of use from agriculture to flexible commercial use

cho-agri-to-school.name: Change of use from agriculture to state-funded school
cho-agri-to-school.description: Change of use from agriculture to a state-funded school

cho-amusements-to-dwh.name: Change of use from amusements or casinos to dwellinghouses
cho-amusements-to-dwh.description: Change of use from amusement arcades or casinos to dwellinghouses

cho-comm-to-school.name: Change of use from commercial buildings to state-funded school
cho-comm-to-school.description: Change of use from commercial or business or service or hotel or similar uses to a state-funded school

cho-commercial-to-dwh.name: Change of use from commercial buildings to dwellinghouses
cho-commercial-to-dwh.description: Change of use from commercial or business or service use to dwellinghouses

cho-commercial-to-mixed.name: Change of use from commercial buildings to mixed use
cho-commercial-to-mixed.description: Change of use from commercial or business or service or similar uses to mixed use including up to two flats

cho-sui-to-dwh.name: Change of use from sui generis uses to dwellinghouses
cho-sui-to-dwh.description: Change of use from takeaway or sui generis or mixed use to dwellinghouses

consent-under-tpo.name: Consent under TPO
consent-under-tpo.description: An application that will affect a protected tree including those covered by a Tree Preservation Order (TPO) or those which grow in a conservation area

demolition-con-area.name: Planning permission for relevant demolition in a conservation area
demolition-con-area.description: An application for planning permission involving the demolition of any unlisted building or structure in a conservation area if permission is required

extend-duration-permission.name: Additional environmental approval to extend the duration of a planning permission
extend-duration-permission.description: If the original planning permission was subject to an EIA or HRA, and the applicant is seeking an extension to the time limit for implementation, the application for Additional Environmental Approval is required.

extraction-oil-gas.name: Development relating to the onshore extraction of oil and gas
extraction-oil-gas.description: An application for planning permission for the onshore extraction of oil and gas onshore, including exploration, appraisal, and production activities. This covers drilling wells, installing associated infrastructure, and any related development required for the extraction process.

footpath-diversion.name: Footpath diversion
footpath-diversion.description: The diversion or stopping up of public footpaths, bridleways, or restricted byways when it is necessary to facilitate development in accordance with planning permission.

full.name: Full planning permission
full.description: This application is needed when making detailed proposals for developments which are not covered by a householder application or permitted development rights

haz-substance-consent.name: Hazardous Substances Consent
haz-substance-consent.description: Hazardous Substance Consent is required when substances on a site are at, or in excess of the 'controlled quantity' as set out in the Planning (Hazardous Substances) Regulations 2015.

hedgerow-removal.name: Hedgerow removal notice
hedgerow-removal.description: An application for anyone proposing to remove a hedgerow, or part of a hedgerow

hh.name: Householder planning application
hh.description: A simplified process for applications to alter or enlarge a single house (but not a flat), including works within the boundary/garden

land-drainage-consent.name: Land Drainage Consent
land-drainage-consent.description: Land drainage consent is required for works affecting the flow of water in an ordinary watercourse, such as a stream, ditch, or culvert, to ensure they don't negatively impact flood risk or the environment. This consent, often granted by the Lead Local Flood Authority (LLFA), is needed for both permanent and temporary works, including alterations to culverts, weirs, or other obstructions.

lbc.name: Listed building consent
lbc.description: An application for works for the demolition of a listed building or for its alteration or extension in any manner which would affect its character as a building of special architectural or historic interest

ldc.name: Lawful development certificate base type
ldc.description: A legal document stating the lawfulness of past, present or future building use, operation or other matters, signifying that enforcement action cannot be carried out against the development

ldc-existing-use.name: Lawful development certificate: Existing Use
ldc-existing-use.description: An application for a certificate confirming that an existing use of land, operational development or an activity being carried out in breach of a planning condition is lawful for planning purposes

ldc-proposed-work-lb.name: Lawful development certficate: Proposed Work to a Listed Building
ldc-proposed-work-lb.description: An application for a certificate confirming whether proposed works to a listed building would be lawful because they do not require listed building consent

ldc-prospective-use.name: Lawful development certificate: Proposed Use
ldc-prospective-use.description: An application for a certificate confirming that a proposed use of buildings or other land, or operations proposed to be carried out in, on, over or under land, would be lawful for planning purposes.

mineral-app.name: Mineral planning applications
mineral-app.description: A mineral planning application is a request for permission to extract minerals or carry out related development.

mineral-extraction.name: Mineral extraction or associated development
mineral-extraction.description: Planning permission is generally required for mineral extraction and associated development from the local Mineral Planning Authority (MPA)

mod-construction-hours.name: Modification of conditions relating to construction working hours
mod-construction-hours.description: Application for modification of conditions relating to construction working hours

mod-discharge-s106.name: Modification or discharge of a Section 106 planning obligation
mod-discharge-s106.description: A Section 106 planning obligation, which is a legal agreement between a local planning authority and a developer, can be modified or discharged through agreement between the parties involved or, if no agreement can be reached, by application to the local planning authority.

non-material-amendment.name: Non-material amendment (S96a)
non-material-amendment.description: An application for any minor changes to proposals that have already been approved

notice-trees-in-con-area.name: Notification of proposed works to trees in a conservation area
notice-trees-in-con-area.description: Notification, 6 weeks prior to works being carried out, of proposed works to a tree in a conservation area that is not subject to a Tree Preservation order

nsips.name: Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects (NSIPs)
nsips.description: Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects are large-scale projects which require consent from the Secretary of State.

outline.name: Outline planning base type
outline.description: Applications that are used to understand whether the basic nature of a development is viable

outline-all.name: Outline Planning Permission with All Matters Reserved
outline-all.description: Outline planning permission with all matters reserved

outline-some.name: Outline Planning Permission with Some Matters Reserved
outline-some.description: Outline planning permission with some matters reserved

overhead-lines.name: Circular 14/90 Overhead lines
overhead-lines.description: Consent required to install or maintain overhead electric lines

pa-accom-defence.name: Accommodation on closed defence site
pa-accom-defence.description: Single living accommodation or non-residential buildings on a closed defence site

pa-build-agri-forest.name: Building for agricultural or forestry use
pa-build-agri-forest.description: Building for agricultural or forestry use

pa-demo-building.name: Demolition of building
pa-demo-building.description: Application to determine if prior approval is required for demolition of a building

pa-demo-replace-dwh.name: Demolish and replace with dwellinghouses
pa-demo-replace-dwh.description: Demolish and replace with a building used as dwellinghouses

pa-ecomms-network.name: Electronic communications network development
pa-ecomms-network.description: Development for an electronic communications network

pa-excavate-agri.name: Excavation or waste deposit for agriculture
pa-excavate-agri.description: Excavation or deposit of waste for agriculture

pa-extension.name: Prior approval: Larger Home Extension
pa-extension.description: An application for prior approval for a proposed larger single-storey rear extension to a dwellinghouse under permitted development rights.

pa-fish-struct.name: Tank cage or structure for fish farming
pa-fish-struct.description: Tank cage or structure for use in fish farming

pa-flats-de-blocks.name: New flats on detached blocks of flats
pa-flats-de-blocks.description: New flats on top of detached blocks of flats

pa-flats-de-comm.name: New flats on detached commercial buildings
pa-flats-de-comm.description: New flats on top of detached commercial buildings

pa-flats-de-dwh.name: New flats on detached dwellinghouses
pa-flats-de-dwh.description: New flats on top of detached dwellinghouses

pa-flats-terr-comm.name: New flats on terraced commercial buildings
pa-flats-terr-comm.description: New flats on top of terraced commercial buildings

pa-flats-terr-dwh.name: New flats on terraced dwellinghouses
pa-flats-terr-dwh.description: New flats on top of terraced dwellinghouses

pa-movable-structure.name: Movable structure for historic attraction or listed hospitality use
pa-movable-structure.description: Movable structure for a historic visitor attraction or a listed pub or restaurant or similar use

pa-road-agri-forest.name: Private road for agricultural or forestry use
pa-road-agri-forest.description: Private road for agricultural or forestry use

pa-roof-solar-nondom.name: Roof-mounted solar PV on non-domestic building
pa-roof-solar-nondom.description: Roof-mounted solar PV on a non-domestic building

pa-sa-solar-dom.name: Stand-alone solar equipment on domestic premises
pa-sa-solar-dom.description: Installation or alteration of stand-alone solar equipment on domestic premises

pa-sa-solar-nondom.name: Stand-alone solar equipment on non-domestic premises
pa-sa-solar-nondom.description: Installation or alteration of stand-alone solar equipment on non-domestic premises

pa-solar-eq-dom.name: Solar equipment on domestic premises
pa-solar-eq-dom.description: Installation or alteration of solar equipment on domestic premises

pa-solar-nondom-park.name: Solar canopy on non-domestic parking
pa-solar-nondom-park.description: Installation of a solar canopy on non-domestic off-street parking

pa-storey.name: Prior approval: Additional storeys
pa-storey.description: Enlargement of a dwellinghouse by construction of additional storeys

pa-tmp-school-vacant-comm.name: Temporary school on vacant commercial land
pa-tmp-school-vacant-comm.description: Temporary school on previously vacant commercial land

pa-uni-building.name: University building works
pa-uni-building.description: Erection extension or alteration of a university building

pip.name: Permission in principle
pip.description: An alternative way of getting planning permission for housing-led development which separates the consideration of matters of principle from the technical detail of the development

prior-approval.name: Prior approval base type
prior-approval.description: This applies to  developments with permitted development rights (where developments are granted planning permission by national legislation without the need to submit a planning application)

psi-app.name: Public Service Infrastructure applications
psi-app.description: Public Service Infrastructure (PSI) applications in planning refer to proposals for major developments related to essential public services like schools, hospitals, and criminal justice accommodation. These applications are subject to specific regulations and accelerated decision-making timelines to ensure timely delivery of these crucial public services.

reg-3.name: Regulation 3 planning application
reg-3.description: Regulation 3 of the Town and Country Planning General Regulations 1992 allows a local planning authority to grant planning permission for its own development, essentially acting as both the applicant and the decision-maker. This means a council can approve development projects on land they own, even if it might otherwise be restricted.

reg-4.name: Regulation 4 planning application
reg-4.description: Where a planning authority applies for permission to develop land they own or have an interest in, but do not intend to develop themselves. In such cases, Regulation 4 dictates that the application is determined by the authority itself, unless the Secretary of State decides to take over the determination.

reserved-matters.name: Reserved matters
reserved-matters.description: An application to provide details on appearance, means of access, landscaping, layout and scale, following an outline application

romp.name: Review of mineral permission (ROMP)
romp.description: The ROMP review is an important piece of legislation allowing MPAs to update older mineral planning permissions to bring them into line with modern standards of environmental protection and planning control, and to impose modern restoration and aftercare conditions.

s73.name: Removal or variation of a condition following grant of planning permission
s73.description: Applications for a removal or variation of a condition after planning permission has been granted

technical-details-consent.name: Technical Details Consent
technical-details-consent.description: Technical Details Consent (TDC) is the second stage of the 'Permission in Principle' (PiP) and is for assessing the detailed design, layout, and other technical aspects of the proposed development.

twao.name: Transport and works act order
twao.description: A TWAO is a statutory instrument made by the Secretary of State under the Transport and Works Act 1992. A TWAO can authorise the construction, operation and maintenance of new transport infrastructure.

waste-dev.name: Waste development
waste-dev.description: An application which involves the use of land for waste management activities like storage, treatment, or disposal
